text.en: The census counted elephants, tigers and leopards in different states of India.

A census is a count of living things. India counts elephants, tigers and leopards in different states.
There are 9103 elephants in Karnataka and Kerala together. We add the numbers by thousands, hundreds, tens and ones, regrouping when we have 10 or more.
Gujarat has 1355 leopards, Karnataka 1131 and Madhya Pradesh 1817. Together they have 4303 leopards.
Estimate first: 1355 is about 1400, 1131 about 1100, 1817 about 1800. The sum is about 4300.
To subtract, regroup when needed. Assam has 5719 elephants, which is 3965 more than Meghalaya, so Meghalaya has 5719 - 3965 = 1754 elephants.
Use blocks: thousands, hundreds, tens and ones, and regroup 1 thousand as 10 hundreds if needed.
